title: trisetaria deyeuxioides
intro: Trisetaria deyeuxioides, commonly known as Deveaux's hair grass, is a type of flowering plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It is traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Trisetaria deyeuxioides include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antiviral activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but they are believed to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites.
